pairs.translation:
Second, the spiritual friend who is the teachings: [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001) [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)
if you cultivate these pith instructions
on coemergent joining over a long period,
the Buddha's teachings, treatises, key instructions, and so forth [N-B013](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b013)
will become known merely through hearing them.
With your own experiential acquaintance through cultivation,
you will realize them to be inseparable, of one taste; [N-B002](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b002)
knowing endowed with certainty will arise.
Free from doubt and a divided mental faculty,
you will gain independent mastery of the Dharma.
Knowing one, you will be skilled in all:
this is called the teacher who is the teachings. [N-B014](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b014) [N-B031](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b031)

Third, the spiritual friend who is appearance: [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)
as soon as you realize phenomena to be ordinary mind,
diverse differentiating conceptualizations, happiness and pain,
and appearances—white, red, whatever appears—
become companions for the arising of realization.
Wherever you stay is an immeasurable palace;
whomever you accompany is a chosen deity.
As soon as this dawns in experience,
that, it is said, is the spiritual friend who is appearance. [N-B031](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b031)

Fourth [?], the teacher who is awareness: [N-B003](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b003) [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)
the five afflictions, apprehended object and apprehending subject,
and all the diverse differentiating conceptualizations of marks [N-B014](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b014)
are realized as one taste: great bliss, non-arising.
Samsara and nirvana are realized as evenness.
As soon as awareness dawns as Dharma embodiment,
an external teacher is no longer needed: [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
when superimposition is cut through within,
this is called the spiritual friend who is awareness.
Those are the characteristics of teachers that have been taught. [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)

Third general meaning: one who is qualified [N-B015](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b015)
is to take these pith instructions of the sublime teacher [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)
into practice as follows. [N-B032](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b032)

Thoroughly cut the ties of dependence on this life.
At a place of accomplished practitioners, or in a secluded place,
on a comfortable small cushion,
sit cross-legged or in whatever posture is comfortable.
Straighten your body; place your hands in the gesture of equipoise. [N-B016](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b016)
Bend your neck slightly;
with both eyes half closed, direct them toward the tip of your nose.
This is the bodily posture.

Then arouse ordinary mind directed toward awakening: [N-B017](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b017)
“For the benefit of every sentient being, [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
and in order that I may attain buddhahood,
I shall cultivate this profound meaning.”
With this thought, ordinary mind is coemergent. [N-B004](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b004) [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)

Having cultivated your own body as the chosen deity, [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012) [N-B018](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b018)
cultivate the sublime teacher at the crown of your head. [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)

Then put on two kinds of armor:
the armor of view and of discerning knowing.
The armor of view is of two kinds:
the profound view and the extensive view.

The profound has four aspects: [N-B019](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b019)
the characteristic of knowing, [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
the characteristic of distinction,
the characteristic of doing,
and the characteristic of essence itself. [N-B005](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b005)

First, the characteristic of knowing: [N-B019](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b019)
through pith instructions and discerning knowing, [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)
identify the characteristic of knowing.
With your own ordinary mind, look at ordinary mind— [N-B020](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b020)
nakedly, within. [N-B022](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b022)

Through looking: non-arising is Dharma embodiment; [N-B021](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b021)
non-cessation is complete enjoyment embodiment;
non-abiding is emanation embodiment.
The three embodiments are conventionally mere illusion. [N-B031](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b031)

Beyond appearances to the conceptual mind that examines verbal expressions, [N-B021](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b021)
free from identification in actual meaning, [N-B022](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b022)
that which transcends the conceptual mind's domain
is the embodiment of essence itself: [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
reflect on this once with vivid clarity.

As soon as the characteristic of ordinary mind [N-B019](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b019)
has been identified as the four embodiments, [N-B022](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b022)
this is called the characteristic of knowing. [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)

Second, the characteristic of distinction: [N-B019](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b019)
“Whatever conceptual thought arises is ordinary mind;
do not reject it—it is the four embodiments.”
Reflect on this once with vivid clarity. [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)

Third, the characteristic of doing: [N-B006](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b006) [N-B019](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b019)
“Although ordinary mind itself is the four embodiments, [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
there is no separate maker of the four embodiments.”
Reflect on this once:
this is the characteristic of essence itself.

None of those phenomena, without exception, [N-B019](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b019)
go beyond the four characteristics:
this is the armor of the profound view. [N-B031](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b031)

The armor of the extensive view is this: [N-B007](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b007)
“Once conceptual thought has dissolved into Dharma embodiment,
samsara and nirvana are realized as evenness; [N-B014](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b014)
though there is no hope for a good result,
conventionally, as mere illusion and dream,
keep the stream of virtue on the white side unbroken.
With confidence in the view of emptiness, [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
though there is no fear of falling into samsara,
reject the ten nonvirtues of the black side.”
Reflecting on this once
is the armor of the extensive view. [N-B031](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b031)
Those instructions show the armor of view.

The armor of discerning knowing is of two kinds: [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
the outer and the inner armor.
For the outer: “Bodily illness
and suffering are not to be rejected; they are Dharma embodiment.”
Reflect on this once.

For the inner: ordinary mind's recollective conceptual thoughts— [N-B023](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b023)
do not reject them; regard them as greatly kind.
View the greatness of their kindness in this way:

“Even the Three Jewels are differentiating conceptualization.
The eight topics and five paths are differentiating conceptualization. [N-B024](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b024)
Even the five faculties are differentiating conceptualization.
The supreme and common attainments are both differentiating conceptualization.
The cause that brings about the attainment of Manjushri
is itself differentiating conceptualization.
It is itself the path and the result.”
Having trained in conceptual thought as the expressiveness of discerning knowing,
the primordial knowing of Dharma embodiment will blaze forth.
At that point, the armor of discerning knowing has been taught. [N-B025](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b025)

Fourth general meaning: in taking up practice, [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
the three kinds of discerning knowing to be cultivated
are taught as hearing, reflection, and cultivation. [N-B026](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b026) [N-B032](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b032)

First, discerning knowing through hearing:
with the eye of pith instructions and discerning knowing, [N-B012](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b012)
look at the characteristic of ordinary mind: [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001) [N-B019](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b019)
“There is no arising and no cessation;
there is no abiding and no entity.” [N-B002](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b002)

With your own voice, utter these words,
just loudly enough for another to hear,
three times.
Listening to them undistracted
is discerning knowing through hearing, it is said.

Second, discerning knowing through reflection:
reflect on the preceding words.
“The three realms, self-appearance, all of samsara and nirvana—
these are ordinary mind's magical display.” [N-B014](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b014)

“Although ordinary mind itself is non-arising,
others apprehend it as arising. [N-B027](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b027)
If it arose, when did it arise?
From a womb, an egg, spontaneous birth,
or warmth and moisture, ordinary mind has not arisen.
From any cardinal or intermediate direction, above or below,
ordinary mind has never been experienced to arise.
From the four elements or from space,
there is no arising of ordinary mind. [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
Even when you search your own body, from its crown
down to the soles of the feet,
ordinary mind is not seen to arise;
therefore it is non-arising.” [N-B008](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b008)
Reflect on this once with vivid clarity. [N-B026](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b026)

“If it ceases, where would it cease?
Nothing in ordinary mind is seen that could cease.
Since it did not arise in the beginning,
there is nothing that could cease at the end.”
Reflect on this with vivid clarity.

“Nor is there abiding for ordinary mind.
In the crown, soles, or limbs,
there is not even an atom's worth of a place where ordinary mind abides.
It does not abide in external objects.
Since it is without arising or cessation,
there is no abiding.
For ordinary mind, there is no abiding whatsoever.”

“If there were an entity,
it would have to be established as shape and color. [N-B009](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b009)
It is established as neither color nor shape— [N-B028](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b028)
red, yellow, white, and so forth;
beyond shape, it is free from identification.”
Reflecting in this way [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
is discerning knowing through reflection, it is said. [N-B022](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b022)

Conceptual thought, in actual meaning, is knowing. [N-B010](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b010)
Like someone who has put doing aside,
do not tighten ordinary mind, and loosen the body.
Since ordinary mind and conceptual thought are inseparable,
clear and free from identification, [N-B022](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b022)
like the midst of clear space,
rest undistracted in that condition. [N-B026](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b026)

Or, it is said, rest in this way:
“Neither send outward nor draw inward.
In the condition where the six collections are self-clear and empty, [N-B029](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b029)
as water is placed in water,
or butter is placed in butter,
rest in the uncontrived, genuine condition.”

Or, it is said, rest in this way: [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001)
“Ordinary mind, differentiating conceptualization, and primordial knowing—the three—
have the essence of bliss-emptiness. In that condition, [N-B029](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b029)
like a butter lamp unmoved by wind,
like an ocean without waves,
like space free from limits,
like a river whose flow is unbroken,
clear, unmoving, and free from identification, [N-B022](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b022)
self-clear in uncontrived essence,
rest undistracted, without interruption.” [N-B026](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b026)

Or one approach is taught in this way:
“All phenomena are differentiating conceptualization; [N-B002](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b002)
differentiating conceptualization is ordinary mind itself. [N-B030](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b030)
That ordinary mind is from the beginning in the condition of non-arising.
Like space free from limits,
ordinary mind itself is clear and free from identification, [N-B022](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b022)
beyond apprehended object and apprehending subject and ‘word-changing imposition’ [?]. [N-B011](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b011)
In its own condition of non-arising,
though there is not a sesame seed's worth to cultivate,
there is not even an instant of distraction.
Rest in the condition of emptiness, bliss, and clarity.” [N-B001](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b001) [N-B031](../translations/NOTES.md#n-b031)

notes.tibetan:
གཉིིས་པ་བཀའ་ཡི་བཤེས་གཉེན་ནི། །
ལྷན་ཅིིག་སྐྱེས་སྦྱོར་གདམས་ངག་འདི། །
རང་གིིས་བསྒོམས་པའི་ཉམས་མྱོང་དང་། །
ངེས་པའིི་ཤེས་པ་སྐྱེ་བར་འགྱུར། །
ཕྱིི་ཡི་བླ་མ་མི་དགོས་པས། །
སྒྲོ་འདོོགས་ནང་དུ་ཆོད་པ་ལ། །
བདག་གིིས་སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི། །
སྤྱིི་བོར་བླ་མ་དམ་པ་བསྒོམས། །
ཤེེས་པ་ཡི་ནི་མཚན་ཉིད་དང་། །
ངོ་བོོ་ཉིད་ཀྱི་སྐུ་སྙམ་དུ། །
ཤེས་པའིི་མཚན་ཉིད་བྱ་བ་ཡིན། །
ལན་གཅིིག་ཝལ་གྱིས་བསམ་པར་བྱ། །
སེམས་ཉིད་སྐུ་བཞིི་ཡིན་མོད་ཀྱང་། །
ངོ་བོ་ཉིིད་ཀྱི་མཚན་ཉིད་དོ། །
སྟོོོང་ཉིད་ལྟ་བའི་གདེང་ལྡན་པས། །
སྙམ་དུ་ལན་གཅིིག་བསམ་པ་དེ། །
ཤེས་རབ་གོོ་ཆ་གཉིས་ཡིན་ཏེ། །
ཕྱིི་དང་ནང་གི་གོ་ཆ་འོ། །
སྤྱི་དོོན་བཞི་པ་ཉམས་བླང་གིས། །
སེམས་ཀྱི་མཚན་ཉིིད་ལ་བལྟས་ཏེ། །
སེམས་ནིི་སྐྱེ་བར་ཡོད་མིན་ཏེ། །
སྐྱེ་བ་མེེད་པ་ཡིན་སྣམ་དུ། །
སྙམ་དུ་སེེམས་པར་བྱེད་པ་སྟེ། །
ཡང་ན་འདིི་ལྟར་བཞག་ཅེས་གསུང་། །
མ་བཅོོས་ངོ་བོར་རང་གསལ་དུ། །
སྟོོོོང་ཉིད་བདེ་གསལ་ངང་ལ་བཞག །
notes.problem: The exact listed lines contain repeated identical Tibetan vowel signs (e.g. གཉིིས་, སྟོོོང་). These are retained in provisional-source-v1; no independent witness has authenticated a correction.
notes.treatment: For English lexical interpretation only, read the repeated identical vowel sign as one. Every listed source string is unchanged. Other lexical or syntactic problems on these lines have separate notes.
notes.uncertainty: High confidence in duplicated-sign interpretation; not textual authentication.
notes.review_action: Check an identified physical witness before correcting the Tibetan.

notes.problem: The listed exact spans lack an expected tsheg.
notes.treatment: English provisionally segments them as གྱུར་པས་, དངོས་པོ་མེད་, and རྣམས་ཐམས་ respectively; no source change.
notes.uncertainty: High confidence from local grammar.
notes.review_action: Confirm segmentation against a witness.

notes.problem: ལྔ་བཞིར་ combines five and four rather than supplying the expected ordinal. The preceding sections are first, second, and third spiritual friends.
notes.treatment: Render “Fourth [?]” as a disclosed conjecture from the enumeration; retain the raw Tibetan.
notes.uncertainty: Fourth is contextually likely; intended written form is unconfirmed.
notes.review_action: Consult a witness; do not accept the reference’s “fifty fourth”.

notes.problem: The line closes the preceding aspiration with སྙམ་དུ་ but then says སེམས་ནི་ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་. It does not transparently say to generate that aspiration.
notes.treatment: Translate its supplied wording as “With this thought, ordinary mind is coemergent.” This retains the anomalous assertion instead of replacing it with an expected practice instruction.
notes.uncertainty: The exact relationship of coemergence to the aspiration is unresolved; source corruption is possible.
notes.review_action: Check the line and its sentence boundary against a witness.

notes.problem: མཆན་ཉིད་ is supplied where the preceding three items and L0275 have མཚན་ཉིད་.
notes.treatment: Render “characteristic” provisionally on the repeated list structure; retain མཆན་ in source.
notes.uncertainty: Strong contextual conjecture, unverified text.
notes.review_action: Verify against a witness.

notes.problem: The paragraph starts with the third characteristic, doing, but closes by naming the characteristic of essence itself. Four are announced at L0245–L0249, yet no explicit fourth ordinal occurs here.
notes.treatment: Keep both supplied labels and their order; do not add a fourth heading, move a line, or harmonize the two labels.
notes.uncertainty: The last line may introduce the fourth or conclude it elliptically; omitted material is also possible.
notes.review_action: Check the four-part structure against a witness.

notes.problem: རྒྱུ་ཆེ་ literally differs from རྒྱ་ཆེ་ at L0244 and L0289.
notes.treatment: Render the first label as “extensive” provisionally from its explicit matching conclusion; leave source unchanged.
notes.uncertainty: Strong parallel support; physical text not checked.
notes.review_action: Verify the opening label.

notes.problem: The supplied thought-quotation particle is སྣམ་, alongside the duplicated vowel in མེེད་.
notes.treatment: Read སྣམ་དུ་ provisionally as the quotation construction སྙམ་དུ་; N-B001 covers the repeated vowel.
notes.uncertainty: High confidence in construction; written form unconfirmed.
notes.review_action: Check the source particle.

notes.problem: དབྱེིབས་ contains mixed vowel signs; unlike N-B001 it is not mere repetition of one vowel.
notes.treatment: Provisionally read the word as དབྱིབས་, “shape,” supported by L0354 and L0356; leave source unchanged.
notes.uncertainty: High confidence from repetition within the same passage.
notes.review_action: Confirm the lexical form against a witness.

notes.problem: The supplied line says རྟོག་པ་དོན་དུ་ཤེས་པ་སྟེ་; it is not an explicit heading “Third, discerning knowing through cultivation.” དོན་དུ་ can mark actuality or purpose.
notes.treatment: Render “Conceptual thought, in actual meaning, is knowing,” taking དོན་དུ་ as actuality and preserving རྟོག་པ་/ཤེས་པ་. Do not supply an ordinal or substitute རྟོགས་པ་.
notes.uncertainty: The predicative attachment is provisional; a defective heading or verbal reading remains possible.
notes.review_action: Verify this line and its relation to the three kinds at L0309–L0311.

notes.problem: The string སྒྲ་བསྒྱུར་འདེབས་ is irregular: སྒྲ་ is word, བསྒྱུར་ is changing, and འདེབས་ can be imposing. A conjecture involving སྒྲོ་འདོགས་, superimposition, would change the source.
notes.treatment: Keep a visibly queried literal placeholder “word-changing imposition” and the established pair “apprehended object and apprehending subject.” The English conjunction is a provisional attachment, not an authenticated reading.
notes.uncertainty: Materially unresolved; literal components do not establish the intended construction.
notes.review_action: Check a physical witness before replacing with a superimposition reading or resolving the attachment.

ཉོན་མོངས་ལྔ་དང་གཟུང་འཛིན་དང་། །
བླ་མ་དམ་པའི་གདམས་ངག་འདི། །

notes.treatment: Use the scoped provisional renderings teacher, spiritual friend, pith instructions, coemergent joining, afflictions, and chosen deity. In the two teacher labels, བཀའ་ is provisionally the authoritative teachings, not the physical faculty of speech.
notes.uncertainty: Working terminology only; owner approval pending.
notes.review_action: Review the linked eight-column proposals and the shared whole-work terminology ledger.

notes.problem: མན་ངག་, ཡིད་གཉིས་ and རང་བྱན་ཚུད་ have no full-expression entries. ཡིད་ is established as mental faculty.
notes.treatment: Keep མན་ངག་ as provisional “key instructions,” distinct from གདམས་ངག་; render ཡིད་གཉིས་ as “a divided mental faculty,” retaining the lexical component; render རང་བྱན་ཚུད་ as “gain independent mastery.” ཆོས་ in this object is provisionally Dharma, the teachings.

notes.treatment: Use marks, one taste, great bliss, and samsara and nirvana provisionally; preserve “evenness” through the fuller མཉམ་པ་ཉིད་. At L0216 great bliss and non-arising characterize the one taste of all items listed.

notes.problem: ཚད་ལྡན་གྱིས་ has an instrumental ending; whether it marks a qualified practitioner or is a defective genitive modifying teacher is uncertain.
notes.treatment: Supply “one who is qualified” as the practitioner undertaking the following practice. This preserves the instrumental rather than silently changing it to a teacher’s possessive.
notes.uncertainty: The alternative is “pith instructions of a qualified sublime teacher” with a genitive emendation.
notes.review_action: Verify the particle and intended participant.

notes.problem: The glossary preserves equipoise for མཉམ་གཞག་ but explicitly leaves posture wording “gesture of equipoise” proposed. ཡིད་ཙམ་ in the next line is an unusual modifier of bending the neck.
notes.treatment: Use “gesture of equipoise” as a locally disclosed proposal for the hands; interpret ཡིད་ཙམ་ provisionally as “slightly” from the posture instruction, not as a standalone occurrence of mental faculty.
notes.uncertainty: The hand construction is clear; the written form behind “slightly” is not authenticated.
notes.review_action: Approve the hand construction and check ཡིད་ཙམ་ against a witness.

notes.problem: བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་ has no whole-expression entry; standalone སེམས་ is ordinary mind. The following lines explicitly give the aspiration to buddhahood for every being.
notes.treatment: Use “ordinary mind directed toward awakening” as a locally proposed composition, retaining the established component. Use buddhahood for the state to be attained, not attainment already achieved.
notes.uncertainty: The term’s technical scope should be approved; the local purpose construction is clear.
notes.review_action: Review a whole-expression addition without weakening standalone ordinary mind.

notes.problem: Both བསྒོམས་ forms govern visualized figures, rather than appearing as abstract nouns.
notes.treatment: Use cultivate, preserving the cultivation family; “as the chosen deity” and “at the crown of your head” express the source predication and location.
notes.uncertainty: The visualization function is supported by the objects; no specific visualization details supplied.
notes.review_action: No terminology substitution; retain for construction review.

notes.problem: The recurrent technical list མཚན་ཉིད་ and its labels ཁྱད་པར་, བྱེད་པ་, ངོ་བོ་ཉིད་ lacks whole-expression entries; the glossary establishes knowing, doing, and essence as neighboring components.
notes.treatment: Use characteristic, distinction, doing, and essence itself. Do not render ཁྱད་པར་ as a new doctrinal stage or བྱེད་པ་ as contrivance.

notes.review_action: Review the family-based additions and the separate four-part structure query.

notes.problem: The source places ordinary mind as both instrument and object. ཅེར་གྱིས་བལྟ་ is not exactly the established ཅེར་མཐོང་ “naked seeing”; L0253 also contains anomalous །་། punctuation.
notes.treatment: Preserve both ordinary-mind roles and render “look nakedly within,” a scoped construction in the seeing family. The anomalous punctuation does not create an omitted phrase.
notes.uncertainty: The seeing-family relation is plausible; this is not naked resting.
notes.review_action: Approve the construction and check punctuation; source unchanged.

notes.problem: The referent of “eight topics” is not identified by the source. “Attainments” after supreme/common is implicit; Manjushri is explicitly named. རྟོག་པ་ཤེས་རབ་རྩལ་སྦྱངས་ has no explicit case marker showing the relation of conceptual thought to discerning knowing’s expressiveness.
notes.treatment: Retain eight topics without naming an external treatise; use five paths/five faculties. Supply attainments for the supreme/common pair, supported by the ensuing attainment construction. Provisionally read conceptual thought as the expressiveness of discerning knowing in the training phrase.
notes.uncertainty: The doctrinal list and that relational “as” need review. Do not identify the eight items from general tradition alone.
notes.review_action: Identify the eight topics from a witness/commentary; approve supplied noun and inspect the training construction.

notes.treatment: Retain the temporal sense, “At that point,” rather than silently changing to “those.”
notes.uncertainty: May be an intentional temporal summary or a copying variation.
notes.review_action: Check source if a demonstrative summary is preferred.

notes.review_action: Retain the reference defect in provenance; any later reuse of reference English needs semantic realignment and fresh checking.

notes.review_action: Check the three lines against a witness.

notes.review_action: Confirm form linkage while retaining the canonical English.
